description: Ports a change already merged on one version line of a package to another (`vN/dev` or `support/N.x`). Checks it belongs there, applies it in a worktree, builds, tests and reviews it, and opens a draft PR. Use when asked to port, backport or forward-port a fix or feature, or apply a change to the other version.
